What this demo represents +

A microscope for the method

This is a small GPT-style teaching model trained on synthetic English sentences. It demonstrates causal language modeling and supervised transfer. It is not the original GPT-1 checkpoint or a reproduction of the paper's benchmark results.

Model details will appear after initialization.

Read the evidence carefully

All displayed training values come from model computation. Loss is measured in natural-log units. Validation uses held-out examples; small synthetic datasets do not establish broad language understanding. Changing the auxiliary loss weight is an experiment, not a promise of improvement.
